title: Replay restores a buffer through a staging buffer: the copy out of srcBuf is not ordered after the copy that initialised it
expected_finding: vkCmdCopyBuffer(initial_contents -> initial_state_src) writes initial_state_src and the next vkCmdCopyBuffer(initial_state_src -> captured_vertex_buffer) reads it in the same command buffer with no barrier between them (transfer-to-transfer read-after-write)
